sentences.arabic: المنبه يرن الساعة ستة، وأقوم مستعجل.

sentences.arabic: مشوار الدوام ياخد ساعة بسبب الزحمة.

sentences.english: The commute to work takes an hour because of the traffic.
sentences.transliteration: mishwaar id-dawaam yaakhud saa3a b-sabab iz-za7ma.

sentences.arabic: بعد الدوام أسوي المشاوير وأشتري المقاضي.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: بَعد الدَّوام أسَوّي المَشاوير وأشتِري المَقاضي.
sentences.english: After work I do the errands and buy the groceries.
sentences.transliteration: ba3d id-dawaam asawwi il-mashaaweer w-ashtiri il-magaadhi.

sentences.arabic: يوم مشغول، بس متعود على الروتين.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: يوم مَشغول، بَس مِتعَوِّد على الرّوتين.

sentences.arabicTashkeel: في الويكِند نِسَوّي شُغل البيت سَوا.
sentences.english: On the weekend we do the housework together.
sentences.transliteration: fi il-weekend nisawwi shughl il-bait sawa.

sentences.arabic: أختي تغسل الغسيل، وأنا أسوي التنضيف.
sentences.arabicTashkeel: أُختي تِغسِل الغَسيل، وأنا أسَوّي التَّنضيف.
sentences.english: My sister does the laundry, and I do the cleaning.
sentences.transliteration: ukhti tighsil il-ghaseel, w-ana asawwi it-tandheef.

scenario.situation: The student and a Jeddawi colleague are chatting during a coffee break about how busy their days are.
scenario.otherRole: The Jeddawi colleague, who has a long commute from north Jeddah.
scenario.goalEnglish: Describe your daily routine, your commute, your errands and housework, and how you spend the weekend.
